checks.description: Entra ID user accounts should be reviewed for active status
checks.query: select display_name, user_principal_name, account_enabled, created_date_time from azuread_user
checks.remediation: Review disabled accounts: az ad user list --filter 'accountEnabled eq false'. Delete accounts no longer needed.

checks.description: Guest user accounts should be reviewed and justified
checks.query: select display_name, user_principal_name, user_type from azuread_user where user_type = 'Guest'
checks.remediation: Review guest accounts: Azure Portal → Entra ID → Users → Filter by User type = Guest. Remove unused guest accounts.

checks.description: Entra ID groups should be used for role-based access management
checks.query: select display_name, security_enabled, mail_enabled from azuread_group
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Guest user accounts should be reviewed and limited
checks.query: select display_name, user_type, account_enabled from azuread_user where user_type = 'Guest'
checks.remediation: Review guest accounts: Azure Portal → Entra ID → Users → Filter by User type = Guest. Remove unused guest accounts.

checks.description: Storage accounts should not allow public blob access
checks.remediation: Disable public blob access: az storage account update --name ACCOUNT --allow-blob-public-access false

checks.description: Storage accounts should restrict network access
checks.remediation: Restrict network access: az storage account update --name ACCOUNT --default-action Deny

checks.description: Entra ID should restrict guest invite permissions
checks.remediation: Restrict guest invitations: Azure Portal → Entra ID → External Identities → External collaboration settings. Set to 'Admins only' or 'Specific admin roles'.

checks.description: Global Administrator role should have limited assignments
checks.query: select display_name, member_type from azuread_directory_role_member where role_display_name = 'Global Administrator'
checks.remediation: Limit Global Administrator assignments to 2-4 accounts. Use PIM for just-in-time access if available (P2 license).

checks.description: Privileged directory roles should have limited assignments
checks.query: select role_definition_id, principal_id, member_type from azuread_directory_role_assignment
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Service principals should be inventoried and reviewed
checks.query: select display_name, app_id, account_enabled from azuread_service_principal where app_owner_organization_id is not null
checks.remediation: Review service principals: az ad sp list --all. Remove unused ones. Rotate credentials regularly.

checks.description: Key Vault should use RBAC instead of access policies
checks.remediation: Enable RBAC: az keyvault update --name VAULT --enable-rbac-authorization true. Migrate access policies to RBAC roles.

checks.description: NSGs should not allow SSH (port 22) from the internet
checks.remediation: Remove or restrict SSH rule: az network nsg rule update --nsg-name NSG --name RULE --source-address-prefixes SPECIFIC_IP/32. Never use * for SSH.

checks.description: NSGs should not allow RDP (port 3389) from the internet
checks.remediation: Remove or restrict RDP rule: az network nsg rule update --nsg-name NSG --name RULE --source-address-prefixes SPECIFIC_IP/32. Use Azure Bastion instead.

checks.description: External identity policy should be reviewed
checks.remediation: Review external identity settings: Entra ID → External Identities. Ensure B2B collaboration policies are appropriate.

checks.description: Admin consent request policy should be reviewed
checks.remediation: Review admin consent settings: Entra ID → Enterprise applications → Consent and permissions.

checks.description: Azure Activity Log should be configured
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Diagnostic settings should be enabled for audit logging
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Entra ID directory audit logs should be available
checks.query: select id, activity_display_name, category from azuread_directory_audit_report limit 5
checks.remediation: Audit logs are automatically generated. If not visible, check Entra ID P1/P2 license or Azure Monitor integration.

checks.description: Entra ID sign-in logs should be available for monitoring
checks.query: select id, user_display_name, status from azuread_sign_in_report limit 5
checks.remediation: Sign-in logs require Entra ID P1 or P2 license. Check your license tier in Azure Portal → Entra ID → Licenses.

checks.description: Azure SQL servers should have auditing enabled
checks.remediation: Enable auditing: az sql server audit-policy update --server SERVER --state Enabled --storage-account ACCOUNT

checks.description: Network Security Groups should have flow logs enabled
checks.remediation: Enable NSG flow logs: az network watcher flow-log create --nsg NSG_ID --storage-account ACCOUNT --enabled true

checks.description: Storage accounts for logs should have immutability policies
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Key Vault should have diagnostic logging enabled
checks.remediation: Enable diagnostic logging: az monitor diagnostic-settings create --name kv-logs --resource VAULT_ID --logs '[{"category":"AuditEvent","enabled":true}]'

checks.description: Storage accounts should have diagnostic logging enabled
checks.remediation: Enable diagnostic logging in Azure Portal: Storage Account → Diagnostic settings → Add diagnostic setting.

checks.description: Virtual machines should have monitoring extensions installed
checks.remediation: Install monitoring agent: az vm extension set --resource-group RG --vm-name VM --name MicrosoftMonitoringAgent

checks.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud should be enabled
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Defender for Cloud should have auto-provisioning enabled
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Virtual machines should have tags for inventory tracking
checks.remediation: Tag VM: az resource tag --ids VM_ID --tags Project=YourProject

checks.description: Entra ID application registrations should be inventoried
checks.query: select display_name, app_id, created_date_time from azuread_application
checks.remediation: Review app registrations: az ad app list. Remove unused applications. Check for expired credentials.

checks.description: SQL databases should have backup retention configured
checks.query: select name, retention_days from azure_sql_database where name != 'master'
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Storage accounts should have blob versioning enabled
checks.remediation: Enable blob versioning: az storage account blob-service-properties update --account-name ACCOUNT --enable-versioning true

checks.description: Entra ID users should have MFA registered
checks.query: select display_name, user_principal_name, account_enabled from azuread_user where account_enabled = true
checks.remediation: Enable MFA through Entra ID → Security → MFA, or configure Conditional Access policies requiring MFA.

checks.description: Conditional access policies should be configured for MFA
checks.remediation: Create Conditional Access policies: Entra ID → Security → Conditional Access → New policy. Require MFA for all users.

checks.description: Entra ID security defaults should be enabled for MFA enforcement
checks.remediation: Enable security defaults: Azure Portal → Entra ID → Properties → Manage security defaults → Enable. Note: incompatible with Conditional Access.

checks.description: Conditional access should use named locations for geo-based policies
checks.remediation: Create Conditional Access policies: Entra ID → Security → Conditional Access → New policy. Require MFA for all users.

checks.description: Entra ID should enforce strong password policies
checks.remediation: Set password policy: aws iam update-account-password-policy --minimum-password-length 14 --require-symbols --require-numbers --max-password-age 90 --password-reuse-prevention 24

checks.description: Device registration policy should be configured
checks.remediation: Configure device registration: Entra ID → Devices → Device settings. Restrict which users can join devices.

checks.description: All Entra ID users should have MFA methods registered
checks.query: select user_display_name, user_principal_name, is_mfa_registered from azuread_user_registration_details_report
checks.remediation: Enable MFA through Entra ID → Security → MFA, or configure Conditional Access policies requiring MFA.

checks.description: NSGs should not allow unrestricted inbound on all ports
checks.remediation: Review all Allow rules with source * and destination port *. Restrict to specific ports and sources.

checks.description: NSG flow logs should be enabled
checks.remediation: Enable NSG flow logs: az network watcher flow-log create --nsg NSG_ID --storage-account ACCOUNT --enabled true

checks.description: Virtual networks should have DDoS protection enabled
checks.remediation: Enable DDoS protection: az network vnet update --name VNET --ddos-protection true. Note: DDoS Protection Standard has significant cost.

checks.description: Storage accounts should have network firewall rules configured
checks.remediation: Set default deny: az storage account update --name ACCOUNT --default-action Deny. Add allowed IPs/VNets as needed.

checks.description: Storage accounts should require HTTPS for transfers
checks.remediation: Enforce HTTPS: az storage account update --name ACCOUNT --https-only true

checks.description: Storage accounts should use TLS 1.2 minimum
checks.remediation: Set minimum TLS: az storage account update --name ACCOUNT --min-tls-version TLS1_2

checks.description: SQL servers should enforce TLS 1.2 minimum
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: App Service web apps should enforce HTTPS only
checks.query: select name, https_only, kind from azure_app_service_web_app
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: App Service should use TLS 1.2 minimum
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Key Vault should have soft delete enabled
checks.query: select name, soft_delete_enabled, soft_delete_retention_in_days from azure_key_vault
checks.remediation: Soft delete is enabled by default on new vaults. Cannot be disabled once enabled.

checks.description: Key Vault should have purge protection enabled
checks.remediation: Enable purge protection: az keyvault update --name VAULT --enable-purge-protection true. Cannot be reversed.

checks.description: Key Vault keys should have expiration dates set
checks.query: select name, enabled, expires_at from azure_key_vault_key
checks.remediation: Set key expiration: az keyvault key set-attributes --vault-name VAULT --name KEY --expires YYYY-MM-DD

checks.description: Key Vault secrets should have expiration dates
checks.query: select name, expires_at, enabled from azure_key_vault_secret
checks.remediation: Set secret expiration: az keyvault secret set-attributes --vault-name VAULT --name SECRET --expires YYYY-MM-DD

checks.description: Storage accounts should have encryption enabled
checks.remediation: Azure Storage is encrypted by default with Microsoft-managed keys. For customer-managed keys: az storage account update --name ACCOUNT --encryption-key-source Microsoft.Keyvault

checks.description: SQL databases should have transparent data encryption enabled
checks.query: select database_name, transparent_data_encryption from azure_sql_database where name != 'master'
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: VM disks should be encrypted
checks.remediation: Enable Azure Disk Encryption: az vm encryption enable --resource-group RG --name VM --disk-encryption-keyvault VAULT

checks.description: Managed disks should be encrypted
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Managed disks should be encrypted
checks.query: select name, encryption_type, disk_state from azure_compute_disk
checks.remediation: Azure managed disks are encrypted by default. For customer-managed keys, create a disk encryption set and associate it.

checks.description: Azure SQL databases should have Transparent Data Encryption enabled
checks.remediation: Enable TDE: az sql db tde set --database DB --server SERVER --status Enabled

checks.description: Security contact should be configured in Defender for Cloud
checks.query: select name, email, alert_notifications from azure_security_center_contact
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.

checks.description: Activity log alerts should be configured for security events
checks.remediation: Review this finding and implement appropriate controls per your organization's security policy.
